name: DevBench
description: DevBench is a multimodal benchmark designed to evaluate language learning abilities across lexical, syntactic, and semantic domains. It includes seven language evaluation tasks with behavioral data from children and adults, enabling comparison of vision-language models to human developmental trajectories.
reputation: A newer benchmark that is increasingly used to study developmental language abilities in vision-language models.
notes: Focuses on comparing model responses to human behavioral data across developmental stages rather than absolute performance.
